description: Test suite for 'agents-utils.ts' containing unit tests for utility functions related to agent models, URLs, and configuration handling in a TypeScript project.

methods.name: resolveEffectiveModelFallbacks
methods.description: Resolves fallback models, preferring entry fallbacks over defaults, returning an array of model strings.

methods.name: resolveConfiguredCronModelSuggestions
methods.description: Collects model suggestions based on configured agent defaults, models, and aliases, returning an array of model identifiers.

methods.name: sortLocaleStrings
methods.description: Sorts strings (or iterable of strings) using localeCompare to ensure locale-aware sorting.

methods.name: agentLogoUrl
methods.description: Constructs the URL for the agent's logo, relative to a given base path.

methods.name: resolveAgentAvatarUrl
methods.description: Determines the avatar URL for an agent based on its identity, preferring runtime URLs over static identity avatars.

methods.name: buildAgentContext
methods.description: Builds an agent context object incorporating workspace and model info, with fallbacks when configuration is missing.
